summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust filed an 8-K reporting that on September 14, 2026, its operating partnership entered an eighth amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo as Administrative Agent. The amendment raises revolving commitments from $1.0 billion to $1.3 billion, reduces margin-grid pricing on the revolver and term loans, releases subsidiary guarantors, and resets the accordion to $700 million. Concurrently, the Company repaid and terminated its Capital One Credit Agreement. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch leverage, pricing step-downs, and guarantor-release covenant flexibility.
